Incident Type: FIXED
Material: MINERAL OIL
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: AEP OHIO POWER COMPANY
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 3 gallons
RECEIVED A CALL ABOUT A LEAKING TRANSFORMER AT THE SITE. A CREW RESPONDED TO THE REPORT AND MADE AN INITIAL ASSESSMENT OF THE SITE. A 37.5KVA POLE MOUNT TRANSFORMER HAD DEVELOPED A HOLE IN THE BOTTOM OF THE UNIT AND WAS SLOWLY DRIPPING OIL. A CLEANUP CONTRACTOR (SUNPRO) WAS CALLED IN TO COMPLETE THE CLEANUP OF THE RELEASED MATERIAL. WHEN THEY ARRIVED ONSITE, THEY OBSERVED THAT A FEW DROPS OF OIL HAD SPLASHED INTO A NEARBY STORM DRAIN. THERE WAS A LIGHT SHEEN OF OIL IN THE DRAIN ON THE STAGNANT WATER IN THE BOTTOM OF THE CATCH BASIN. NO WATER OR OIL LEFT THE DRAIN DRAIN CATCH BASIN. IT IS ESTIMATED THAT ONLY TWO TO THREE GALLONS OF OIL WERE RELEASED IN TOTAL.

properties.content:

Nearest City: Warren, MI

Material: RADIOACTIVE MATERIAL (POSSIBLY POLONIUM)
Medium Affected: NON-RELEASE (N/A)
Suspected Responsible Party:
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER IS MAKING A REPORT OF AN OLD ANTI-STATIC BRUSH, WHICH IS USED FOR CLEANING FILM NEGATIVES, THAT POSSIBLY COULD BE A RADIOACTIVE HAZARD. CALLER DID OPEN THE WRAPPING THE BRUSH WAS INSIDE OF BUT HE IS CONCERNED BECAUSE THE BRUSH LOOKS OLD AND DECAYED. CALLER STATES THERE IS ALSO A WARNING LABEL ON THE BRUSH THAT READS "DON'T TOUCH THIS AREA OF THE BRUSH". SINCE THE WRAPPING WAS OPENED THE CALLER SUSPECTS WHATEVER MATERIAL IS ASSOCIATED WITH THE BRUSH COULD HAVE TURNED INTO A POWDERY SUBSTANCE AND LEFT A RUSTY RESIDUE BEFORE HE OPENED IT (THE MATERIAL COULD BE "POLONIUM"). CALLER OPENED THE WRAPPING AROUND 1900 AND IMMEDIATELY NOTIFIED 911 AND THE POISON CONTROL. THE FIRE DEPT. RESPONDED AND ARRIVED ONSCENE AT APPROX. 2000. THE FIRE DEPT. PERFORMED THREE DIFFERENT TYPES OF "GEIGER COUNTER TESTING FOR ALPHA, BETA, AND GAMMA RADIATION" AND DETERMINED THERE WERE NO UNUSUAL READINGS EXCEPT ON THE BRUSH ITSELF (THE BRUSH DID GET HIGH READINGS). CALLER HAD LIMITED INFORMATION BUT WAS TOLD BY THE POISON CONTROL TO ALSO NOTIFY OTHER AGENCIES. THE FIRE DEPT. DID LEAVE THE SCENE AND CALLER STATES THE BRUSH IS CURRENTLY IN A TRASH CAN.
